Tirupur does one thing better than almost any other city in India — it exports knitwear. More than ₹32,000 crore in garment exports flow out of this city every year. Behind every export consignment is a factory. Behind every new factory is a construction project. And behind every construction project is a site office that the contractor needs the day the excavator arrives — not three weeks later when the RCC room is ready.

That is the gap SAMAN fills in Tirupur.

We manufacture MS-frame steel porta cabins at our Gopasandra facility in Bangalore (560099) and deliver to Tirupur. Our cabins are factory-built, ISO-certified, dispatched directly to your site — no dealer, no middleman, no assembly on your plot. A site office, a security guard room at a garment compound gate, a material store cabin at a dyeing unit yard — we build all of these and deliver them to your Tirupur address, typically within 4 to 5 days of dispatch from Bangalore.

We are a porta cabin manufacturer in South India with over 500 projects completed since 2009. Three ISO certifications. NSIC registered. DPIIT recognised.

Why Tirupur's Garment Economy Creates Consistent Porta Cabin Demand

Most industrial cities have one or two busy periods for construction each year. Tirupur does not work that way. The garment export cycle is constant — factories expand before peak season, new units start construction year-round, and the dyeing and yarn-processing ancillary belt runs separate construction timelines from the knitwear assembly plants. The result is that someone in Tirupur is always building something, which means someone in Tirupur always needs a site office cabin.

Garment factory construction sites: A new knitwear factory building in Tirupur typically runs for 8 to 18 months from foundation to handover. The construction contractor needs a site office for the project manager, a cabin for the site engineer, and sometimes a separate materials inspection room where fabric samples and hardware deliveries are checked before storage. These are the most common porta cabin enquiries we receive from Tirupur.

Factory compound security: An operating garment factory compound — particularly one that handles export shipments — needs controlled entry. A security cabin at the main gate is standard. Many factories have a separate delivery bay with its own security post. A 10 ft × 8 ft MS steel security cabin with a sliding window, a counter ledge, and a single AC point is the most requested configuration from Tirupur factory operators.

SIDCO Industrial Estate, Harvey Road (PIN 641602): The SIDCO Harvey Road estate in Tirupur hosts a mix of knitwear units, yarn processors, and engineering support firms. Industrial estate construction and unit expansion inside SIDCO creates regular demand for contractor offices. We deliver to Harvey Road addresses — confirm the entry procedure when placing your order.

Dyeing and bleaching unit yards: The fabric processing units in Tirupur's surrounding belt — Avinashi Road, Kangeyam Road, and the outer ring — handle large volumes of yarn and fabric that are staged in open yards before and after processing. Material store cabins and supervisor shelters at these yards are a specific requirement we supply regularly.

Labour housing and rest room demand: Large garment factory campuses with on-site labour need rest rooms and canteen structures. A 40 ft × 8 ft cabin divided into sections — rest area, toilet block, canteen counter — is a standard multi-unit supply for Tirupur campus projects.

Tirupur's Climate and Why It Changes What You Should Specify

This section matters more for Tirupur than for most cities in this region. Tirupur sits in the western Tamil Nadu plains at approximately 300 metres elevation — lower and hotter than Coimbatore, with higher humidity than interior cities like Salem. Average summer temperatures reach 38 to 40°C, and the combination of heat and humidity inside an uninsulated steel cabin on a garment factory site is a genuine problem for worker productivity and material protection.

We address this in the specification before the cabin leaves our factory.

PUF panel insulation: Every SAMAN porta cabin uses 40mm PUF sandwich panel as standard. The polyurethane foam core is a genuine thermal barrier — it measurably reduces internal temperature compared to uninsulated sheet steel. For Tirupur sites with all-day direct sun exposure, we recommend our upgraded 60mm PUF option.

Heat-reflective roof sheet: Our standard GI roof sheet carries a heat-reflective coating on the outer surface that reduces radiant heat gain into the cabin. On a Tirupur summer afternoon, this single feature can reduce the internal temperature by 3 to 5 degrees compared to a plain GI sheet.

Ventilation: For cabins without AC, we include fixed MS louvre vents in the upper panel wall section to create passive cross-ventilation. Hot air rises and exits through the louvres; cooler air enters from the lower window level. For dyeing unit yards where the site manager does not need full AC but cannot work in a sealed metal box in May, this combination — insulated panels, reflective roof, upper louvres — makes a real difference.

AC provision: For a fully air-conditioned site office, we include the panel cut-out, bracket, copper pipe sleeve, and condensate drain so your AC unit is installed and running the day the cabin arrives.

Specifications

Frame: Mild steel IS 2062 grade hollow sections. Factory-cut, welded, inspected, and primed at our Bangalore facility under ISO 9001:2015 quality management (Certificate E20250218645). No field welding at your Tirupur site.

Panels: 40mm PUF sandwich panel as standard. 60mm PUF available for high-exposure Tirupur sites. Cement fibre board available as an alternative for dyeing unit yards where panel impact resistance matters more than thermal performance.

Roof: GI sheet with zinc anti-corrosion coating and heat-reflective outer surface. Tirupur's monsoon (northeast monsoon October to December plus some southwest monsoon spillover) is handled by standard GI sheet with correct overlap, ridge capping, and sealed fixings.

Floor: Anti-skid chequered steel sheet standard. 18mm plywood-on-MS cross-members for office-use cabins. Tile floor in toilet compartments.

Doors: MS powder-coated door, single or double leaf, with mortise lock. Painted wooden door option available. For garment compound security cabins, we recommend a wider single-leaf or double-leaf door to allow comfortable passage for delivery personnel carrying samples.

Windows: Sliding glass in aluminium section frame, fixed MS mesh vent, jalousie louvre, or any combination. For Tirupur security cabins where the guard needs a view of the entry road and a pass-through counter, we include a fixed MS counter ledge below the sliding window.

Non-standard sizes built to your footprint. If your compound gate has a specific clearance or your plot has a corner constraint, send us the dimensions.

Customisation — Every Item Confirmed Before Manufacturing

Electrical: Single-phase wiring designed for your declared load — laptop and printer in a site office, industrial sewing machine power outlet in a production support cabin, or basic LED and fan for a security post. MCB board with correctly rated circuit breakers. Earth leakage protection. Wall switches and sockets at positions you specify. External power inlet point for generator connection on sites without permanent power.

AC provision: Panel cut-out at the height your indoor unit requires. Bracket for outdoor unit on cabin wall. Copper pipe sleeve. Condensate drain outlet. Ready for your AC technician on day one — no improvised drilling into the panel after delivery.

Counter ledge for security cabin: Welded MS flat-bar counter at the correct height below the guard cabin sliding window — standard for Tirupur garment compound security posts. Specify when ordering.

60mm PUF upgrade: For sites facing full western afternoon sun in Tirupur's summer, the 60mm PUF panel replaces our standard 40mm. The extra foam thickness provides meaningfully better thermal performance. Specify at enquiry stage — cannot be added after manufacturing begins.

False ceiling: 12mm plywood or PVC tongue-and-groove panel on MS sub-frame at 7 to 7.5 feet clear height inside. Reduces the cabin volume the AC manages and eliminates the unfinished roof-sheet ceiling appearance in a garment company's professional site office.

Toilet compartment: 4 ft × 4 ft or 5 ft × 4 ft wet room — FRP tank, WC, wash basin, floor trap, 4-foot tile dado. Standard addition for site offices in Tirupur where the site manager is present full-time during a long construction project.

Partition wall: Divide a 20 ft × 10 ft cabin into a manager's room and a clerk's room or document storage room. Each with its own door.

Exterior: Two-coat enamel in your colour. For garment company sites, we can include a company name board in enamel on the exterior front panel.

500+ projects completed. For garment sector buyers in Tirupur who need vendor certification for a factory audit or buyer compliance check, we supply ISO certificate copies, NSIC papers, and GST registration as part of your order documentation.

Delivery to Tirupur

Dispatch point: Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099
Route: NH 44 to Krishnagiri and Dharmapuri, then NH 544 via Erode or Salem direction to Tirupur
Distance: approximately 430 kilometres
Transit: 4 to 5 days from dispatch to your Tirupur address

The cabin arrives on a flatbed truck. A crane or telehandler is required at your delivery point for offloading. A 5-tonne mobile crane handles standard cabins up to 20 ft × 8 ft. Heavier fitted units need 7.5 tonnes. We confirm the cabin weight with your delivery note.

Placement: a levelled hard surface is sufficient. No RCC foundation for temporary use. For permanent garment compound security cabins or long-term factory site offices, anchor bolt fixing plates in the base frame and a bolt pattern drawing are available on request.

We deliver to SIDCO Harvey Road (641602), garment factory zones across Tirupur, and all Tirupur city and district addresses including Avinashi Road, Kangeyam Road, and the outer ring belt.

Browse our porta cabin for site office range for full specifications and product photos. Nearby South India pages: porta cabin in Coimbatore and porta cabin in Madurai.

Use the prefab cabin range to see all available sizes and configurations.

Pricing

Every cabin is priced to your specification. No published price covers every configuration. What determines your cost:

Size: All material and labour scales with external footprint and height. Accurate size at enquiry gives you an accurate quotation.

Panel type: Standard 40mm PUF is most cost-effective. 60mm PUF upgrade for Tirupur high-heat sites adds a modest material premium. Cement fibre board is an alternative at a similar price point.

Fit-out level: Bare structure with door and window is the minimum. Fully wired, AC-ready, insulation-upgraded, false-ceilinged, toilet-attached site office is at the other end. Every item between adds cost in proportion to material and labour — no padding.

Tirupur climate upgrades: The 60mm PUF upgrade and heat-reflective roof are the two items specific to Tirupur's conditions. The roof coating is standard on all our cabins at no extra charge. The 60mm PUF upgrade carries a material premium. Tell us your site exposure conditions when enquiring and we recommend the right specification.

Freight: Tirupur is 430 kilometres from our Bangalore factory. Freight for a small cabin is lower than for a heavy fitted unit. Quoted as a separate line item — no hidden delivery charges.

Written quotation with complete line-item breakup within 24 hours of your enquiry.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can you supply porta cabins for a garment factory construction site in Tirupur with fast delivery?

Yes. For a standard 10 ft × 8 ft or 20 ft × 8 ft cabin with no custom fit-out, manufacture takes 7 to 10 working days and transit to Tirupur is 4 to 5 days. Total from order to delivery: 11 to 15 working days. For custom fit-out with electrical, insulation upgrade, AC provision, and toilet: 14 to 20 working days total. If your construction start date is fixed, call us with the date and we confirm whether it is achievable from our current production queue.

Will a standard porta cabin handle Tirupur's summer heat comfortably?

A standard 40mm PUF panel cabin with heat-reflective GI roof and upper louvre vents provides meaningful thermal protection. For sites with all-day direct western sun exposure — common on open garment factory construction sites — we recommend the 60mm PUF upgrade plus AC provision. A 1.5-tonne split AC in an upgraded PUF cabin maintains a workable internal temperature even at 39 to 40°C outside. Specify the upgrade at enquiry stage — it cannot be added after manufacturing begins.

Can you supply the security cabin with a counter ledge for a garment compound gate in Tirupur?

Yes. A fixed MS flat-bar counter ledge below the sliding window is a standard add-on for garment factory security cabins. Specify it when enquiring and we include it in the manufacturing plan. The counter is sized to the window width and welded to the cabin frame — not bolted on as an afterthought.

Do you supply vendor documentation for garment buyer compliance audits in Tirupur?

Yes. If your factory audit requires vendor certification for any cabins installed on your compound, we supply ISO certificate copies (9001, 14001, 45001), NSIC registration, DPIIT recognition letter, and GST registration document. Request the documentation file when placing your order and we include it with your delivery paperwork.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For porta cabins in Tirupur, Tiruppur, SIDCO Harvey Road, or garment factory sites across the Tirupur belt:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. When using the enquiry form, include your cabin size, use, quantity, climate specification preference, and Tirupur delivery address — we return a complete written quotation without a follow-up call.
